column5: F: ERP costing handling. | M: How the browser twin books cost, and what it does when costing cannot post.

column3: method card; every cell read while recording
column5: F: Costing, end to end. | M: A shipment is booked at cost, and which cost depends on the costing method. We re-posted real documents in real iDempiere and in the twin, and compared. Blue is iDempiere, green is the twin.
F: Take one shipment. Re-posted under Average PO, iDempiere books thirty of cost of goods. Under Standard, twenty. | M: The twin books the same, to the cent.

column4: M: The method is a schema setting.
column5: M: The method is a setting on the accounting schema. Here it is Average PO, and the choices are iDempiere's own. | F: Average Invoice, Average PO, Fifo, last invoice, last PO price, Lifo, and Standard. | M: A new client starts on Standard costing, as in iDempiere. This demo company uses Average PO.

column3: card: a sale, done behind the card
column5: F: Now a sale. A point of sale order for Joe Block: one Mulch. | M: We press Complete. The model layer reserves the stock, creates the shipment and the invoice, takes the payment, and posts all of it in one transaction. | F: The shipment is booked at the product's cost, which is where the costing method matters.

column4: M: Cost of goods, two seventy.
column5: M: The shipment's books: cost of goods two dollars seventy, inventory asset two seventy. | F: Balanced, and complete.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT sweep.methods A 9/9, S 9/9, I 9/9, p 9/9, i 9/9, F 5/9, L 4/9
column5: F: Nine documents both systems hold, re-posted under each method. | M: Average PO and Standard: all nine equal, books, status and notices. | F: Average Invoice, last PO and last invoice agree too, but this company has no such cost element, so that proves little. | M: Fifo: five of nine, and iDempiere itself fails on this data. Lifo: four of nine, the twin does not yet create the missing cost element. Those two are next.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT pilot.m_inout.E=682, by class 650/11/1; postError before 2/8, now 8/8; staging
column5: F: When costing cannot post. In iDempiere's demo database, six hundred eighty-two shipments are stuck in status Error. | M: Six hundred fifty because stock would go negative under Average PO. Eleven reversals whose original was never posted. One with no cost. | F: Before this week the twin would have booked such a sale as posted, and let the stock go negative. Now it says Error and leaves a notice. The same case passes eight of eight. | M: To put the twin in that position, one product's cost record is set to zero quantity. iDempiere does not allow that edit on screen either. Then one is sold.

column4: M: The shipment is in Error.
column5: M: The shipment's Posted button reads Posting Error, and it has no accounting lines.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT notice.text (exception, product, quantities, cost element, schema)
column5: F: And the notice window holds the message. The same exception, the product, the quantities, the cost element and the schema, as iDempiere writes it. | M: One difference we state: the twin prints zero and minus one where Java prints zero point zero.
M: Standard and Average PO are proven end to end. Fifo and Lifo are next.
